title: PM Imran Khan vs Ashraf Ghani | Imran Khan befitting reply to Afghan President in Live ceremony
description: PM Imran Khan Vs Ashraf Ghani | Imran Khan Befitting Reply to Afghan President in Live Ceremony |  #PMIRANKhan #ASHRAFGHANI #UZBEKISTAN  PM Imran Khan Complete Speech At the International Conference on "South Asia-Central Asia Regional Connectivity-Chleslenges and Opportunities in Tashkhent.   The Prime Minister has said that Afghanistan can play a bridge between Central and South Asia.   Prime Minister Imran Khan arrived at the International Congress Hall to attend the Central and South Asia Regional Connective Challenges and Apartions 2021 conference in Tashkent on the second day of Uzbekistan's visit, where Uzbek President Shaukat Mirzaev welcomed Prime Minister Imran Khan. The two leaders also discussed important issues. Apart from Prime Minister Imran Khan, the UN Secretary General and the President of Afghanistan were also present at the conference.  Imran Khan said that Pakistan will continue to support all measures of peace, reconciliation, reconstruction and economic development in Afghanistan. We will work with all the neighbors of Afghanistan and all relevant international parties to find a solution through dialogue.      The premier said the situation and the unresolved disputes are the key challenges to Peace and stability in the Region. He said Neighbour Country is the natural land bridge between Central Asia and South Asia, and Peace is the most critical factor for regional connectivity.  Imran Khan Said Pakistan Foremost Priority is the stability in Neighbour Country as it is directed. He said Pakistan will Continue to Support All Initiatives for Peace. He said we encourage all the neighbours and international stakeholders for their positive rules for a political settlement.   The Prime Minister Imran Khan Expressed Disappointment Over The allergies Against Pakistan from Ashraf Ghani.  He said to blame Pakistan for what is happening in the neighbour country is extramely unfair. Prime minister Imran Khan categorically stated that Pakistan is a partner in Peace. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- Welcome to the official channel of Dunya News - Pakistan Top News Network Delivering the latest from the globe. asr.full_text: The Pakistan, China Pakistan Economic Corridor, CPEC, is the flagship project of BRI. It entails greater connectivity and trade linkages through a network of rail, road, fiber optic cable, energy pipelines, industrial clusters, and special economic zones. We do not see CPEC project as an exclusive enterprise. We hope CPEC can stimulate further regional cooperation and be the foundation of a much larger connectivity network based on mutual cooperation. Excellencies, regional peace and stability are paramount for an optimal result. I foresee two key challenges in this context. First is the situation in Afghanistan. Second, outstanding disputes keeping the region fragmented and least integrated for decades. Afghanistan is the natural land bridge between Central and South Asia. These in Afghanistan remains the most critical factor in translating this connectivity vision into reality. Our foremost priority is stability in Afghanistan. As it directly affects us, Pakistan will continue to support all initiatives for peace and reconciliation, as well as reconstruction and economic development of Afghanistan. to continue to support all our initiatives for peace and reconciliation, as well as reconstruction and economic development of Afghanistan. We encourage all neighbors of Afghanistan and recently international stakeholders to work together for facilitating a negotiated political settlement. Excellencies, I just want to make a couple of comments because President Ashof Ghani mentioned Pakistan's negative role in this conflict going on in Afghanistan. President Ghani let me just say that the country that is going to be most,000 casualties in the last 15 years. The last thing Pakistan wants is more conflict, our economy is finally recovering from one of the most difficult phases which we've been through. And I repeat, the last thing we want is turbulence in Afghanistan. I can assure you that no country has tried harder to get Taliban on the dialogue table than Pakistan. We have made every effort short of taking military action against Taliban and Pakistan, we have made every effort to get them on the dialogue table and to Have a peaceful settlement there. To blame Pakistan for what is going on in Afghanistan I feel is extremely unfair. I came to Kabul. Why would I come to Kabul if I was not interested in peace? The whole idea was that you should look upon Pakistan as a partner in peace. I feel really disappointed that we have been blamed for what is going on in Afghanistan. What is happening in Afghanistan is over two decades of conflict, deep divisions, and unfortunately, the United States seeking a military solution when there was not one. When there were 150,000 troops, NATO troops in Afghanistan, the greatest military machine, that was the time to ask the Taliban to come on the table. Why were the Taliban going to compromise when the exit date was given and when there were only a they believe in the military system of Pakistan are not safe, when Pakistan is the only country that has the status of civilized Islam, which is the only country where the state was given and there were only few thousand American troops left, why would they listen to us when they are sensing victory, Uzbekistan, how we can all get together and somehow help the peace process in a political settlement because it is all of our interests, all the neighbors is Pakistan today. The second major challenge to this connectivity initiative are the regional unsettled disputes and this is between Pakistan and India. The whole area opens up if Pakistan in India are main issues in Kashmir, if we can resolve that issue, just imagine the impact the huge market of India on one side, China on the other side, connectivity between Central Asia, Pakistan, the whole area changes and unfortunately because of our dispute, unresolved disputes, the huge potential remains untapped. Finally, once again I want to congratulate President Shaukat and his team on the successful launch of this extremely important initiative. President Shaukat, I want to – on behalf of my delegation, especially thank you for the great hospitality you've shown us. The dinner last night where you organized a mix between Uzbekistan Cultural Show and Pakistan Culture Show has deeply touched us because the extent you went to make us feel to show your hospitality and make us feel at home I want to be very thanks from all my delegation, thank you very much. Prime Minister Imran Khan was talking through a conference when he mentioned I am waiting to see the result of this attack. Afghanistan's role in central and southern Asia in the Middle East. At this time, Prime Minister Imran Khan said that the allegations against Pakistan are unfortunate. We have made every possible effort to bring the Taliban to the table of dialogue and establish peace. Prime Minister also said why the Taliban will listen to us when they have seen victory? He said that he was disappointed. He was not pleased to see the allegations upon Pakistan
